authority: Operational dispatch mirror only; live main/accepted evidence and canonical Drive governance override this file.

defaults.sourceDependencies: W00-W19 accepted as applicable; DP6 satisfied if Device Plane ships
defaults.mission: Final cross-system reconciliation, production-like E2E staging, performance/economics, stress/failure/DR, physical Android E2E, cleanup/deprecation, rollback manifest and Release 1.0 decision.
sources: - Action Plan v0.4.1 W20 + physical-device amendment

tasks.title: W20-00 - Release Coordination, Reality & Acceptance Freeze
actions: 1. Revalidate every required W00-W19 acceptance and exact main state.
2. Freeze Release 1.0 scope, included Device Plane profile, staging environment and acceptance matrix.
3. Identify unresolved deprecations, migrations, feature flags and rollback dependencies.
4. Define final KPI baseline vs target and release blockers.
5. Create release premortem including rollback/kill-switch/DR and governance drift.
tasks.forbidden: Do not waive upstream missing acceptance by documentation assertion.

tasks.title: W20-A - Cross-System Reconciliation
actions: 1. Audit packages/contracts/schemas/registries/services for duplicate truth, stale compatibility shims, cycles and ownership drift.
2. Verify canonical IDs/versioning/public exports and consumer builds.
3. Reconcile Drive/GitHub status/evidence/deprecations.
4. Remove or explicitly retain obsolete runtime paths.
5. Produce final architecture inventory.
tasks.forbidden: Do not rewrite accepted architecture without explicit blocking finding/change control.

tasks.title: W20-B - Production-Like End-to-End Staging
actions: 1. Run representative goals from intake through context/router/capability/DAG/policy/authority/executor/readback/evidence/outcome.
2. Cover provider/workflow/domain and device paths included in release.
3. Use staging/sandbox/non-destructive controls.
4. Verify correlation/evidence reconstruction.
5. Capture pass/fail and residual issues.
tasks.ownership: Staging E2E harness and coordinated fixes.

tasks.title: W20-C - Final Performance & Economic Baseline
actions: 1. Compare baseline vs final quality, latency p50/p95/p99, compute/model/tool/retrieval cost and business outcomes.
2. Measure queueing/fan-out/concurrency and resource pressure.
3. Verify Fast/Governed routes meet intended tradeoffs.
4. Confirm efficiency never removed mandatory safety/evidence.
5. Document capacity limits and SLO readiness.
tasks.forbidden: Do not tune by bypassing Policy/Authority/Executor/Evidence.

tasks.title: W20-D - Fast/Governed Lane & Parallel DAG Stress
actions: 1. Stress 1,500 simultaneous objectives and ~10,000 downstream tasks/events or calibrated equivalent.
2. Exercise bounded concurrency, cancellation, fairness, joins, timeouts and overload degradation.
3. Attempt Fast Lane misclassification under risk.
4. Measure retry/queue storm behavior.
5. Verify deterministic/consistent completion and no side-effect duplication.
tasks.forbidden: Unbounded fan-out or authority bypass blocks release.

tasks.title: W20-E - Cache / Context / Template / Router Invalidation & Rollback
actions: 1. Test semantic cache hit/miss/invalidation, ContextSnapshot staleness and conflicting facts.
2. Test template/version rollback and adaptive router rollback.
3. Verify stale precheck/context/cache/templates never authorize execution.
4. Exercise model/strategy fallback and safe degradation.
5. Record rollback time/evidence.

tasks.title: W20-F - Provider / Workflow Failure, Rate Limit, Quota & Uncertain Execution
actions: 1. Inject provider timeout/rate-limit/quota/outage and n8n/webhook failures.
2. Exercise EXECUTION_UNCERTAIN, readback/reconcile-before-retry and circuit breakers.
3. Verify credentials/tenant/account bindings under degradation.
4. Test delayed/duplicate callbacks and evidence.
5. Prove no duplicate irreversible side effects.

tasks.title: W20-G - DR / Restore / Kill Switch / Rollback Rehearsal
actions: 1. Execute backup/PITR/restore and service recovery drills.
2. Verify outbox/inbox/evidence/read models consistency after restore.
3. Exercise global/component kill switches and rollback manifest.
4. Measure RPO/RTO and manual/degraded procedures.
5. Prove recovery state reconciles external side effects.
tasks.forbidden: Do not declare recovery if external state is unknown/unreconciled.

tasks.title: W20-H - Physical Android E2E / DP7
actions: 1. If Device Plane is included, run command -> policy -> authority -> ActionIntent -> Device Executor -> app/hardware -> Receipt -> readback/evidence on physical device.
2. Cover offline, permission denied, app missing, session expired/revoked, duplicate command, late receipt, disconnect, EXECUTION_UNCERTAIN and kill switch.
3. Verify battery/resource/lifecycle constraints as relevant.
4. Capture device/build/environment evidence.
5. Close DP7 only on complete pass.
tasks.forbidden: If Device Plane is excluded, record explicit release scope rather than fabricating pass.

tasks.title: W20-I - Cleanup, Deprecation, Provenance & Release Artifacts
actions: 1. Close DEPRECATION_REGISTER items required for 1.0.
2. Remove stale branches/shims/artifacts where safe and preserve accepted historical evidence.
3. Verify salvage/reference material is not runtime dependency.
4. Finalize migrations/rollback notes/operator runbooks and provenance/license records.
5. Run secret/cleanup scans.

tasks.title: W20-J - Release Manifest & Final 1.0 Decision
actions: 1. Assemble exact release SHA, PRs, CI, migrations, feature flags, dependencies, risk residuals, SLO/DR/security evidence and rollback manifest.
2. Run final Reality Gate and exact-main Quality/Test Build/Security.
3. Require all P0/P1 blockers resolved.
4. Decision must be READY_FOR_RELEASE, BLOCKED or explicitly scoped non-release; no ambiguous 'mostly ready'.
5. Synchronize GitHub/Drive status and publish Release 1.0 acceptance.
tasks.forbidden: Never trade safety/authority/evidence completeness for schedule.
